content: Printavo/YoPrint (print-shop SaaS) table stakes: quotes convertible to orders, line-item pricing, mockup/proof approval links, deposit + final payment tracking, status pipeline quote-to-pickup, due dates and rush flags, production calendar, customer CRM with order/payment history, profitability reporting and KPI dashboards, inquiries inbox fed by website contact form, QuickBooks export. YoPrint adds pricing matrices, purchase orders, customer portal.
